description: This file contains a function 'preinit_set_mac_address' that sets MAC addresses for various board models during the pre-initialization phase of the system boot. It sources functions from '/lib/functions.sh' and registers a boot hook to execute this function early in the boot process.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets MAC addresses based on the detected board model during system pre-initialization, tailored for different hardware configurations.
